parameters.help_zh: DN多规格变配时，每个DN的目标规格
parameters.name: specified_dn_spec_map_json

parameters.help_en:
The switching time. Valid values:
0: Immediately.
1: Within the O&M window
parameters.help_zh:
切换时间
0: 立即执行
1: 在运维时间内执行
parameters.name: switch_time_mode

parameters.help_en: The start time of the switchover. The switchover is performed within the period from the start time T to T+30 minutes. This parameter is not available
parameters.help_zh: 切换开始时间，切换时间为：[开始时间T, T+30m]，暂未开放使用
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
The target cloud disk size after the specification change.

If the instance uses a fixed-size cloud disk, you cannot change the cloud disk size. In this case, do not specify DnStorageSpace.
Valid values of DnStorageSpace: 20 to 3072
parameters.help_zh:
变配目标磁盘大小

实例为固定大小磁盘时，不能变配磁盘，此时不传 DnStorageSpace
DnStorageSpace 范围：[20, 3072]
parameters.name: dn_storage_space

parameters.help_zh: 是否在修改实例规格时对齐存储节点的主可用区
parameters.name: align_storage_primary_azone

OrderId.description_en: The order ID. An order is generated when you upgrade or downgrade an instance, or change the instance specifications
